node.statement: Uniform approximate orthogonality of the target projections. Fix an amplification and write p_i=I_n tensor P_i and r=p_1+p_2-I_n tensor I. The rho-projection and approximate-complementarity clauses give ||p_i^2-p_i||<=rho and ||r||<=rho. For e=rho+epsilon below a fixed universal ceiling (take e<=1/4), the C*-lower and triangle inequalities give (1-epsilon)||p_i||^2<=||p_i^2||<=||p_i||+rho, hence ||p_i||<=2. For k!=l, bilinearity and p_1+p_2=I+r give p_k p_l=p_k r+(p_k I-p_k)+(p_k-p_k^2). The product-norm and approximate-unit axioms therefore yield ||p_k p_l||<=(1+epsilon)||p_k||rho+epsilon||p_k||+rho<=4e. All constants are independent of n.
